title: Payment API outage
resolution: Restarted affected service and increased the connection pool limit
lesson: Monitor database connection usage before saturation

title: Checkout timeout
root_cause: Slow database queries caused API requests to time out
resolution: Identified the slow query, added an index, and restarted the service
lesson: Check database query latency during checkout incidents

title: Notification service failure
resolution: Restarted the queue consumer and replayed failed messages
lesson: Check queue consumer health before investigating application code
